``` r
library(OpenMx)
library(fitDTVARMxID)
library(metaVAR)
library(manMetaVAR)
```













## Data Generation


``` r
taskid <- 9
seed <- 42
set.seed(seed)
data <- GenData(taskid = taskid)
```


``` r
plot(data)
```

<img src="fig-vignettes-sim-rep-unnamed-chunk-10-1.png" width="3300" /><img src="fig-vignettes-sim-rep-unnamed-chunk-10-2.png" width="3300" />

``` r
summary(data)
```

## MetaVAR


``` r
dtvar <- FitDTVAR(data)
```


``` r
summary(dtvar, means = TRUE)
#> Call:
#> fitDTVARMxID::FitDTVARMxID(data = data$data, observed = paste0("y",
```
